name: Cart — add to cart shows line item

planSteps.description: Navigate to /collection/all and open the first product card
Click an enabled size button (e.g. 'M' or 'S') so a size becomes selected
If an availability/date calendar is visible, click the first enabled (not greyed-out) future date cell, then confirm a 'Selected Date' label appears
Click the primary 'Book Rental' / 'Add to collection' button, then navigate to /checkout
The checkout page shows the product as a cart line item with its name and price (i.e. NOT the 'Your Bag is Empty' message)
